title: davallia pinnatifida
intro: Davallia pinnatifida, commonly known as the Lady Fern, is a species of fern in the family Davalliaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues due to its bronchodilatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Davallia pinnatifida are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
